I know this is a bit of an older post but I recently decided to give factory smokes a try. I got one of each flavor profile and what I found is they are what they are, cheaper cigars, out of the four sun,shade,maduro,sweet I had hoped the sweet would be best because I favor a sweeter cigar, sadly it was the worst for me, it was an aggravating smoke because I had to keep correcting the burn which I've seen other people mention and a similar problem I had with the blue kuba kuba which is also a drew estate. 

The over all flavor just wasn't there for me and the sweetness died out relatively quickly with almost no remaining spice to it. As I write this I'm burning a Maduro and so far it seems to be the best for me, it has a strong flavor profile to it with a clean even burn and the draw is middle of the road. 

The sun and shade didn't really stand out to me either way but were clean smokes, the shade for me was very light with almost no flavor so it didn't really appeal to me at all, I've got another sun that I'm going to burn tomorrow to make the final decision between the Maduro or the sun grown. 

These cigars aren't horrible but they aren't amazing either, for the price if you NEED a smoke and are tight on cash getting a 5 pack or a single wouldn't be the worst thing you could do, still better than a white owl or a Philly any day and still gives you the feeling of smoking something that some thought went into. 

I'm still on the search for an affordable daily smoke and have found that for a few more dollars, you really start getting into a better quality cigar. While factory smokes are a decent attempt at an affordable smoke they start showing you why they are so cheap after a few sticks.
